verdict.line: You lose the lane if you get caught in melee range once Renekton hits level 3 and eats the full E into empowered W stun chain; you win it if you poke with Q from max range and only step up once his E (Slice and Dice) is down.

brief.thesis: Renekton's entire kit is built around one gap-close: E (Slice and Dice, 450 range) into W (Ruthless Predator) stuns, gated by Fury crossing 50 and by E's cooldown. Gangplank's Q (Parrrley) hits from 625 range, farther than any Renekton tool reaches, and W (Remove Scurvy) directly cleanses the stun that makes his all-in work. Play the range gap and the cleanse correctly and a matchup that's even overall (53% GP winrate across 2,102 games, solo-kill even) tilts clearly toward you.

theirWindow.what: He dashes in with E, then opens with the empowered 3-hit W (1.5s stun, destroys shields, high damage) instead of the normal 2-hit 0.75s stun. This is his only real all-in window — hold W (Remove Scurvy) to cleanse the chain and heal back rather than spending it early.

yourWindow.what: He has no way to close the 625-325 range gap to your Q, so poke freely with Parrrley every 5 seconds and walk back. Once his E is burned (wave clear, reposition, or a missed engage) he's stuck in melee range for 16 to 10 seconds depending on rank.

powerCurve.note: Cull the Meek sustain and low-HP Fury ramp win early trades
Full E-into-W stun combo comes online
Dominus adds bulk, but W cleanse answers it
Essence Reaver core online, poison and poke scale
Crit and on-hit damage outscale his flat Fury kit

start.why: The highest-winrate start (52.9% over 1,959 games) gives the HP and sustain to survive the level 1-2 window where Renekton's Cull the Meek heal wins extended trades.

boots.why: 50.8% pick rate at 52.1% winrate — flattens the burst from his auto-attack-into-W stun chain, which is your main source of chip damage in melee range.

core.why: Mana sustain lets you spam Q (5s cooldown) to poke all lane without running dry, which is the entire win condition here.
Converts your ranged poke into real kill pressure once trades start landing — the 57.3% winrate path over 349 games.
Crit scaling turns your late-game 1v1s into the clear advantage the power curve shows from level 9 onward.

situational.when: renekton or his team builds armor to blunt your poke
his team has heavy healing and the Cull the Meek sustain is still relevant in fights
you need the shield to survive his empowered W all-in instead of relying on W cooldown alone

runes.keystoneWhy: Burn damage on ability hit rewards a poke-and-retreat Q pattern rather than standing in melee range trading autos with him — exactly the trade shape this lane calls for.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick (91.9% pick rate) and lets you punish a failed E all-in or close out a poke-down kill. Flash+Teleport actually wins more (54.3% over fewer games) if you'd rather play the lane passively and split pressure instead of looking for kills.

playing.title: Poke from max Q range
playing.detail: Parrrley hits from 625 range, well outside Renekton's 450-range E and 325-range Q. Throw it on cooldown and step back before he can close the gap.

playing.title: Hold W for the stun chain
playing.detail: Don't burn Remove Scurvy on minor chip damage. Save it to cleanse the W stun, especially the empowered 3-hit, 1.5s version at 50+ Fury that also strips your shields.

playing.title: Watch the Fury bar before trading
playing.detail: Past 50 Fury his Q deals and heals more, and his W becomes the longer, shield-destroying stun. Bait that threshold out safely rather than trading into it.

playing.title: Trade only when E is down
playing.detail: His E (Slice and Dice) is his only gap closer, with a 16-to-10s cooldown by rank. Once he spends it on anything else, step up and layer Q plus your passive poison autos before it's back.

playing.title: Respect level 6 but don't fear it
playing.detail: Dominus gives him bonus health and area damage around himself, but your Cannon Barrage doesn't need to answer it directly — use the global slow and damage over time to punish his dive afterward instead of brawling his tankier form.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not kills
playing.detail: Essence Reaver into The Collector into Infinity Edge (57.3% winrate) is the strongest path. Your on-hit poison and crit damage both get better with time, so prioritize farm over forcing fights early.

playing.title: Use E to swing skirmishes
playing.detail: Raise Morale reaches 1200 range and buffs AD and move speed for nearby allies on a 20s cooldown. Pop it before a 2v2 or jungler gank — Renekton has no equivalent tool to answer the buffed damage and speed.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability breakdowns, cooldown call-outs, and trade-window reasoning are my own analysis of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Use [Q] whenever Grasp of the Undying comes off cooldown. Otherwise, use it whenever Bone Plating is off cooldown while checking his Fury.
